chunks: And Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār narrated from al-Ṣādiq, from his father, peace be upon them:
That ʿAlī, may the blessings of Allah be upon him, found parts of a deceased person, so they were gathered together, then he performed the funeral prayer over them, then they were buried.

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: his father, referring here to Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.الصَّادِقِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the narrator in the chain
key_terms.عَلِيّاً: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, whose action is being reported
key_terms.قِطَعاً: scattered parts or pieces of a body

ai.seo_question: Should salat al-janazah be performed over separated parts of a deceased person if they are found and gathered?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام gathered scattered parts of a deceased person, performed the funeral prayer over them, and then had them buried. It indicates the prescribed funerary dignity and legal treatment of human remains even when the body is not intact.
